deviations_from_card: Guard case 6 (BUDGETS) rides inside the janky-vs-clean guard test and was already held by slot A's guard; guard case 7 was red before only because verdict() did not exist (it is a guard on a new function). Case 6's report is written from scene/--all runs only (not the self-test or --url). runScenes keeps its boolean return and gains an optional 4th 'done(summary, results)' callback; formatLine/summarize/report exported from perf-gate.mjs. Verdict also fails a scene with no control reading (an extra test).
notes: perf:chores with the still control (Chrome, run by hand twice): FAIL both times, 'a 80 ms task at press Enter +0 ms' and 'a 76 ms task at press Enter +1 ms', while the still control measured right after ran NO long task (longTaskMs 0, frameP95 16.8) - so the chores red is the scene's, not the machine's: verdict 'fail', not 'inconclusive'. It is reproducible and tied to the drive's press Enter step; worth a Lane B fix rather than a re-run. typecheck exit 2 and lint exit 1 are all sibling paths (src/lib/halo.test.ts, src/halo/model.test.ts, src/stores/devices.test.ts, src/lib/mirror.ts; e2e/support/shell.ts) - none in my files; the full desktop test suite was green (2721 passed).
